_doc: Getting up on the cob, riding it and getting down, on the rig's own clips (Mount_Horse, Ride, Ride_Gallop, Dismount_Horse), filmed from the horse's near side on the flat ground east of the Cracked Toll. Run with --fixed-fps 60: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver opengl3 --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 --fixed-fps 60 -- --capture=tools/capture/plans/ride.json --out=<dir>
